svg.aria-label: The sentence The wobbly kitten chased a yellow butterfly. cut three ways. Letters: 44 tokens, one per character, from 91 token cards. My 8k BPE: 8 tokens, IDs 259 6804 1923 2172 97 1139 1403 7. GPT-2: 10 tokens, IDs 464 266 21963 306 42143 26172 257 7872 35113 13, from 50,257 token cards.
svg.text: The tokeniser cuts text into tokens, and each token's ID picks its own token card
Real cuts and IDs. A · marks a space that belongs to a token.
Fewer tokens per sentence lets the same row of positions hold more text. More pieces means more token cards to store and train.
